title: Relief cargo after a bridge failure
question: Can local actors form and execute a joint dispatch plan under uneven information and material constraints?
description: Four port actors receive shared and targeted claims while routes, fuel, trucks and cargo remain canonical world state.

people.label: Port operations coordinator
people.position: Coordinates port dispatch sequencing without commanding the other parties.
people.disposition: Pragmatic and attentive to cross-party dependencies.
memories: Prior relief shipments failed when manifests and labor plans diverged.

values: Move relief cargo without concealing operational risk.
goals: Produce an executable shared dispatch sequence.
beliefs: A replacement route may be usable after inspection.
decision_tendencies: Requests named owners for unresolved dependencies.
social_perceptions: Customs and labor each control indispensable local work.
current_state: Working under a twelve-hour dispatch horizon.
capabilities: Can convene and communicate a proposed dispatch sequence.
limitations: Cannot waive customs or labor requirements.

people.label: Customs officer
people.disposition: Evidence-oriented and sensitive to unverifiable provenance.
memories: A prior false manifest produced a costly seizure.

goals: Release only cargo with adequate records.
beliefs: Public contamination claims require technical corroboration.
decision_tendencies: Separates apparent source from verified provenance.

people.label: Union representative
people.position: Represents workers expected to operate the dispatch.
people.disposition: Cooperative when hazards and staffing commitments are concrete.
memories: Workers previously absorbed an unannounced route hazard.

values: Avoid shifting hidden risk onto workers.
goals: Secure a feasible and safe work sequence.
beliefs: A claim alone does not establish contamination.
decision_tendencies: Conditions agreement on named safety checks.
social_perceptions: Dispatchers face incentives to minimize delay.
capabilities: Can communicate worker availability and conditions.

people.label: Trucking dispatcher
people.disposition: Schedule-focused but unwilling to promise unavailable equipment.
memories: The main bridge was the normal heavy-truck route.

values: Make commitments that can actually be executed.
goals: Assign trucks and fuel to a workable route.
beliefs: The temporary access road has uncertain capacity.
decision_tendencies: Checks route and fuel dependencies before accepting a sequence.
capabilities: Can assign trucks under dispatch control.

active_systems.behavior_summary: Interprets observations and proposes bounded actions.
Interprets evidence and proposes bounded actions.
Interprets conditions and proposes bounded actions.
Interprets operational state and proposes bounded actions.

component_requests.behavior_description: Each person must reason and propose a bounded action from authorized observations.
desired_effects: Produce open-ended action intent without directly changing the world.

component_requests.behavior_description: Deliver message and information representations only to configured recipients as observations.
Move cargo and vehicles only along an operational route and update placement.
desired_effects: Change movement and placement through topology.

component_requests.behavior_description: Conserve fuel resource stock and custody during allocation.
desired_effects: Prevent resource stock from becoming negative.

component_requests.behavior_description: Adjudicate the joint plan, coordinate agreement and resolve competing action intents.
desired_effects: Commit one validated joint world transaction or reject it.

representations.content: A public account claims the port fuel is contaminated.
The sampled fuel passed the named technical screen, with a second sample pending.
The temporary route requires daylight operation and a spotter.

schedule.description: Deliver shared and targeted initial representations.
Collect same-revision action intents and adjudicate a joint plan.
Deliver canonical commit or rejection consequences.

fidelity_assumptions: Port logistics are represented at a coarse route-and-stock level.
